$Comment: The Moonbloom's stun: a thrown Moonbloom's burst puts it on the hunter or enemy player it catches, through CommonLib's control landing, which holds them exactly as a CommonLib stun does (what they were doing stops, a creature's attacks pause until it wakes). It is built on the game's own Stun, as CommonLib's Zig_Stunned is. Its ZigEffectFamily tag puts it in the Stunned effect family, so everything that reads a stun sees it: a target already stunned is not stunned again, and whatever wakes a stunned target or clears stuns ends it. Its ZigControl Fixed tag makes it a fixed control, so it lasts exactly the round's stun length on every server: no control resistance, added time, immunity or immunity ramp changes it (what a fixed control skips is on CommonLib's Crowd Control screen). HorizontalSpeedMultiplier 0 holds a creature in place; MovementEffects and AbilityEffects are what a stunned player's own game reads. The round's rule set sets its length, so this file's Duration only counts for a plain ApplyEffect. Its ZigWeakSpot tag makes every hit on a stunned target a weak spot while it lasts. Restyle it by shipping a file with this same id.
